changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard forms. Added PaLM as it's the base model for PaChiNCo. Removed specific Codex variants as they're covered under 'Codex'. Added more specific output description.
The extracted metrics are correct and complete. The paper uses pass@k metric and execution-based evaluation comparing output DataFrames.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators of generated outputs. LLMs are used for generation, not evaluation.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations of the generated code outputs. Evaluation is entirely automatic using execution-based metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on code generation for data science tasks in computational notebooks. The evaluation is primarily automatic using execution-based metrics (pass@k and output matching). No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. The paper introduces the ARCADE benchmark and evaluates several code generation models including their custom PaChiNCo model.
